title: Yi Sang
wikitext:
{{Infobox Character|sinner_number=1}}
'''Yi Sang''' is Sinner #1 of Limbus Company. He was a member of the [[League of Nine]] and is closely connected to [[Dongrang]] and the invention of the [[Mirror]].

== League of Nine ==
Yi Sang belonged to the League of Nine Littérateurs. His relationship with Dongrang is established there and later revisited in [[Canto IV]].

== The Mirror ==
Yi Sang is associated with the Mirror, a device and concept that later becomes central to Limbus Company's technologies and identities.
